title: Good Reminder App
body:
This is a really good app, it lets you put # Tags and other features to organize your Reminders, and of course it lets you repeat the reminder Daily, Monthly, Yearly etc.

But I found a bug, on my iPhone running latest version as of 2024, and updated App Version, I normally receive a notification to remind me of what I needed to be reminded of, for some reason, it stopped!

Please fix this bug, appreciate it!

👍

title: It didn’t update.
body: Up until recently I didn’t notice that this app could be updated, then one day I looked at my reminders thinking if I could make it more interesting, so I browsed throw the internet for some information only to find that Apple had released an updated version of reminders since iOS 13 and now I’m on iOS 15 and this app still looked the same for years, I tried looking for more information and the only solution I’ve got is to restart my iPhone completely and I don’t want that!! But seriously, it frustrating finding out that some iPhones got fully updated and others didn’t, Apple needs to fix this.
